related_questions.question: What are the new rules for Southwest?

text_blocks.snippet: Southwest Airlines is undergoing significant changes, including the introduction of assigned seating, new fare bundles, and updates to baggage policies. Passengers booking flights on or after January 27, 2026, will be assigned seats. The "bags fly free" policy is ending, with fees starting for checked bags booked on or after May 28, 2025. Southwest is also introducing new fare options like "Choice Extra," "Choice Preferred," "Choice," and "Basic".
snippet_highlighted_words: Passengers booking flights on or after January 27, 2026, will be assigned seats

list.snippet: Southwest is transitioning away from its open seating policy.
Assigned seating will be available for flights booked on or after January 27, 2026.
Passengers can select from standard, preferred, or extra legroom seats.
The new system will group passengers into boarding groups based on seat selection and loyalty status.
Southwest is introducing "Choice Extra," "Choice Preferred," "Choice," and "Basic" fare bundles.
These bundles combine seating, checked bag, and boarding options into a single purchase.
"Choice Extra" offers extra legroom, free checked bags, and pre-boarding.
"Choice Preferred" provides preferred seating and boarding at the start of general boarding.
"Choice" offers a standard seat.
"Basic" assigns your seat at check-in and is the most restrictive.
The "bags fly free" policy is ending.
Checked bag fees will apply to flights booked on or after May 28, 2025.
The first checked bag will cost $35, and the second will cost $45.
Business Select fares and some Rapid Rewards members will still receive free checked bags.
The new boarding process will group passengers by seat location.
Passengers with premium seats and top-tier loyalty members will board first.
Passengers with "basic" fares will board last.
Portable battery chargers must be kept visible and out of bags while in use.
The cabin will be prepared for landing at 18,000 feet instead of 10,000 feet.

text_blocks.snippet: Southwest Airlines allows free cancellations and changes for all fare types up to 10 minutes before the scheduled departure time. Refunds depend on the fare type: Business Select and Anytime fares are refundable, while Wanna Get Away and Wanna Get Away Plus fares are converted into flight credits or transferable flight credits.
